verdict.rationale: An independent TechPowerUp review gives all four memory specs for the RTX 5070 Ti: 16 GB capacity, 28 Gbps GDDR7 memory, a 256-bit bus, and 896 GB/s bandwidth. A Hacker News commenter separately confirms the 28 Gbps memory speed. missing for 10: a first-party NVIDIA spec sheet stating these memory figures (none of the NVIDIA pages in the pack list capacity, type, bus width, or bandwidth), and corroboration of capacity, bus width and bandwidth beyond the single review.
